title: mnemonica .tactica control
description: Control flow of one .tactica source (format version 1.1): `callers` — the call paths that lead to constructor invocations, walked outward from each creation site to the entry points — and `points`, framework steps supplied by generator plugins. Data flow is the runtime lineage; this file is what makes it happen. See tactica/README.md for the join rules.

version.description: Format version. control.json is new in 1.1; absent means 1.1.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Informational only; readers must not require it.

callers.description: The call paths ending in constructor invocations.

nodes.description: Scopes that hold a constructor invocation or sit on a call path to one.

edges.description: Calls between nodes, caller → callee, the callee being closer to the invocation site.

anchors.description: The constructor invocation sites, each pinned to the node holding it.

points.description: Framework steps around the entry points (e.g. guards, interceptors, pipes, filters, middleware), supplied by generator plugins. Absent or empty when no plugin supplied any.

location.description: `file:line:col`, 1-based, relative to the project root — see tactica/README.md "location".

scopeId.description: A scope's identity: the file path for a file's top level, `file:line:col` of the scope start for a function, method or closure.

name.description: Display label: the function name, `Type.method` for methods, the bound variable or property for closures, `file:line` for anonymous ones, the file path for a file's top level.

kind.description: What the scope is. Generators write "module" (a file's top level), "function", "method", "arrow" (TS); other languages add their own (e.g. a Python lambda, a Go func literal). An open string: readers tolerate values they do not know rather than failing.

filePath.description: The file holding the scope, relative to the project root.

starter.description: True when no caller was found: an entry point of the application (often a scope a framework calls).

typePath.description: The fullPath of the type being constructed.

constructorText.description: The constructor expression exactly as written at the site.

rooted.description: True when the holder is a file's top level: an instance created at module scope. Absent means false.

variable.description: The variable the new instance is bound to, when the generator can tell.

kind.description: The framework step. The nestjs plugin writes "guard", "interceptor", "pipe", "filter", "middleware". An open string: plugins of other languages and frameworks bring their own.

code.description: The point's source text (signature or registration line).

scope.description: Where the step attaches. The nestjs plugin writes "global", "module", "controller:<Name>", "method:<Type>.<method>". An open string.

targets.description: Names of the types the step attaches to; empty for global steps.
